name: How do I prepare my home for contractors to complete repairs from a sale list?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for contractors to complete repairs from a sale list?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for contractors involves clearing personal items from work areas, ensuring access to necessary utilities, and informing the contractor of any specific instructions or concerns. For example, if a plumbing repair is needed, ensure the area under sinks is clear. If an electrical issue needs addressing, ensure the breaker box is accessible. Maine Results, Inc. values clear communication; we will provide guidance on what specific preparations are needed for your scheduled repairs, minimizing disruption and helping our team work efficiently within your home in Boise or surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home by clearing work areas, ensuring utility access, and communicating any instructions to the contractor.
